leakage_controls: The evaluator opens only the held-out fixture named in this manifest.
The training fixture is declared solely to make exclusion reviewable; it is never used for evaluation, policy fitting, threshold selection, or expected-metric calibration.
No learned policy or tunable parameter is present in this v1 reference evaluation, so the tuning partition is intentionally empty rather than silently reusing held-out data.
A fixture hash may appear in exactly one family partition.
